items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: The Baptist comes, he's got to stand up and pray... See the Baptist, they all sing on the same style... when I was playing, used to play for the church

ctx.x: Oh, back to the funeral. When they have a man laid out, what is in the old days on this cot deal, rolling cot, what would they have around him?

Well they wouldn't have nothing more than a sort of a veil over him, you know. That's all kind of flies and things, you know. They have a veil over them and some people would have, you know, bring flowers or something. Well they would set the flowers right at the head or at the feet, you know. They wouldn't set it in front because people walk towards the front and different people, because if a cattley walks in there, he's going to lead and make a prayer, see. The Baptist comes, he's got to stand up and pray, you…
But did you ever see a clock at a deal like this, you know, in the old days, marking an hour of death?
